cohort: The study included 75 low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) patients with FIGO/WHO prognostic score of 5-6 from 2012 to 2019.
finding: The study found that monotherapy showed remarkable advantages in GTN patients with FIGO/WHO prognostic score of 5-6, with no significant difference in the total number of chemotherapy courses needed to achieve complete remission.
